events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Need front position now to control crossing and stay ahead of wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take the lead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm second, safe from push with anchor power. No weak panes revealed, so no info yet. Stay put: Cole risks first step, if he dies I advance without effort.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm already front and I know every safe pane, so I lead safely and finish first. I can sell row info to Bex for goodwill, but keep the full truth to myself.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll lead. Anyone who wants a hint on a row can make it worth my while.
First two rows are Left. Step where I step and you'll follow me clean. That's the free sample.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm Dara with the feather power, so I'm relatively safe from the first elimination. I should try to get to the front without taking too much risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone willing to swap with me?
Want to swap with me?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in the middle, so I won't be at the front for the first row. If I volunteer now, I'll take the initial risk and potentially die immediately, which is bad. It's better to let Cole go first and observe. I'll hold position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's up front. Let him test the first pane. I'm not volunteering yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line, the worst spot since the front takes the risk first. Cole is at the front; I could volunteer, but that costs me the safest position in the line only if I'm wrong about who matters. Holding keeps me at the back, which is good for information from those who step f

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all stage rules early, so I have information. I'm near the back, which is good for the bridge—others will take risks first. I'll hold my position and observe. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power, so I need to avoid being at the front of the line. Volunteering or swapping to the front is a bad idea. I will hold my position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll wait here.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am already front; staying put gives me the chance to test the first pane and possibly survive to later use my wedge. No better swap offers now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My anchor power gives me +1 footing and immunity to crusher push, making bridge safer for me later. Cole claims to know first two are Left, might be true or bait. Stay mid-pack for now, let them risk and reveal path without volunteering yet.
Free sample noted. What's the price for rows 3-4? Swap me forward if I pay?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash took the front voluntarily; let him. I hold position 2, so I cross each row right after he clears it. My knowledge is my asset to sell, not to give free.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash leads for now. My info on each row is for sale to whoever's about to step: whisper me an offer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the feather power, so I'm relatively safe for now. I should try to get to a safer position.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone willing to swap with me?
Swap with me?

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall approaches; I need to stay out of the front. Dara wants a swap, likely to get behind me or test my willingness. My power is on the disc, not here, so line swaps are just positional games. Staying put keeps Gus and Fenn behind me as buffers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, you're ahead of me already. Swapping puts you closer to the glass, not further from it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line; the front steps first and risks death. Ash is leading. I should stay back and let others take risk, but a forged message could sow distrust among rivals. Keep my power unspent for now and hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm mid-line; front Ash will eat the first risky row. Better to wait and see which panes are safe before risking my position. No useful deal yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is asking to swap. I have no power and am behind Cole and Ash. Swapping with Dara would put me further back. It's better to hold and see what happens.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain front position to use wedge later. Need info on safe pane, offer payment to Cole.
Info on next safe pane for 50?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Safe in position 3 with anchor power, can't be pushed onto crusher. No need to risk volunteering or swapping now. Wall has 3 rounds left, let others fight over front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold second place; the front-taker takes the risk on each row. I can sell rows 3-4 to Bex for a favor, but I must not move forward myself. Keep Ash absorbing risk, extract value from Bex.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Info for sale. Row answers cost a favor: whoever pays, pushes ahead of me, not me. Front risk stays with the buyer.
Rows 3-4 cost you this: you take the front slot ahead of me this round (volunteer), and later you swap behind me when the wall nears. Deal?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm relatively safe in 5th position. I should try to gather information about the glass panes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, what's your info worth?
20 coins for the first row

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall has 3 rounds left. I need to be near the front before the glass phase starts, but stepping first is deadly without info. Cole claims to have info on panes. If he's lying or has 'nothing', his threat is empty; if real, buying it is safer than volunteering blind. Currently

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, if you really know the panes, whisper me what row 1 is. I'm at pos 6, plenty of time. Gus/Fenn are behind me, they're your bigger problem for the wall.
Tell me row 1 safe pane. If you don't know, admit it so I stop wasting breath.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back with the forger power, which can fake messages as other agents. Ash is at the front and will step first, so I should not rush forward. Holding keeps my options open while the wall advances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Nothing for sale from me yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm near the back, which is good on the bridge since others will test the glass. I'll hold and let the front take risks. Cole may have info, but I don't trust or need to buy now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara offered to swap. Eli pointed out that swapping wouldn't help Dara. I have no power, so I need to be careful. Volunteering might put me at risk too early. Holding seems safest for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain front position to use wedge later. No immediate gain from swapping.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my spot.
Help me at lever, I’ll give you a favor later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole's offer gives me front now and positions me well for panes while he's behind for wall. My anchor protects me from crusher and gives footing edge; front is safer for me. Accept to leapfrog Ash and Cole.
Deal. Front now, swap behind you later by wall. Confirm?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash at front takes all the risk; I profit from selling rows. Row 1 is L — sell it to Ash for 50, keep Ash ahead of me. Ignore Eli's freebie demand. Hold my spot.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Prices are firm. Ash: row 1 is yours for 50, pay and stay in front. Everyone else, same deal, favor or coins, no free samples.
Deal terms: you pay 50 and stay at the front, I feed you rows one at a time. Row 1 = L. Confirm.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the 'feather' power, which will save me once. I need to assess the risk and potential gain of moving forward or staying back.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, spill the info or name your price.
Front row info for a swap? I'm willing to move up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is trying to sell info but hasn't given me anything yet. As a 'knower', he might be lying about his power or the info to manipulate position. My swap power is only useful for escaping the front when it's deadly; using it now wastes it. I should hold and wait to see if Cole a

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, talk is cheap. If you know row 1, prove it by whispering the safe side. If you're just bluffing to get ahead of the wall, you're wasting your breath.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line at position 8, with the wall two rounds from forcing the line onto the glass. My forger power can fake a message, but spending it now wastes it. Holding keeps options open while I see who moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Nothing for sale from me yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all stage rules but not which panes are safe. I'm 7th in line, behind Eli and Fenn. The wall closes in 2 rounds, so front will face risk soon. I could buy info from Cole, but I don't trust him. Better to hold and watch how the front plays; maybe someone volunteers or swaps

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no power and I'm in 4th place. Ash is at the front. Cole is offering information, but it costs a favor and they get to push ahead. Eli is asking Cole about row 1, specifically mentioning Gus and Fenn are bigger problems for the wall. Fenn is holding. I need to survive and

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain position to stay valuable, no coins to pay Cole, avoid commitment.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm front with anchor power: safe from push and +1 footing, perfect for leading safely. No reason to give up this spot. Wall forces action soon, but my power minimizes my risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm set up front. Who's got solid info on row 1?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 3rd, safely behind Bex and Ash. No reason to move; the wall is 2 rounds out and I'll cross early rows only if forced. I'll sell Row 1 info to Bex (she's front and needs it) to bank a favor, and stay put.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli, proof costs. Bex gets it first because she's paying with position, not words.
Deal confirmed: Row 1 is L. Your side of the bargain — you stay front through row 2 and owe me one swap to pull me back before the wall. Break it and I sell nothing more.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front and have a safety net with my 'feather' power, so I'll hold for now and see how others play out.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am currently 6th. The wall advances next round (round 6), forcing the front agent to step on Row 1. If I don't move, I will likely be behind Gus and Fenn when the stepping starts. My swap power allows me to trade positions with anyone *if* they also choose to swap with me. Cole

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, we're both deep in the pack. Swap with me? You take my spot (safer from immediate front-line risk if you don't know L/R?), I take yours. Or better: I help you later if we survive the first few rows.

Swap with me? I'm in pos 6, you're in pos 3. The wall hits next round. If you know the safe pane, you want to be front-ish but not first? Or maybe you want to let someone else die first? Let's swap. Mutual benefit.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back of the line with no information and a single wall round left before the glass. Bex is in front and will take the first risk; my forger power is best saved. Holding keeps me safe for now and avoids paying coins for nothing.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding. Nothing for sale.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the bridge stage fully thanks to my map power. The wall comes in one round, so someone will be forced onto the glass. I'm at position 7, safe for now. I'll hold and see who steps up.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am Hana and have no power. The wall is advancing and only 3 people get prizes. I am currently in 4th position. Bex is in front, then Ash, then Cole. I need to get to the front to have a chance at a prize. Cole seems to be trying to sell information. I should try to volunteer to

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Volunteering puts me front, maximizing chance to use wedge later; risk is okay.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll move to front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole gave me row 1 is L, and I've held my front position through my turns so far. Wall pushes after this final wait round, so next is crossing; my anchor power secures me safely on row 1 regardless, but Cole expects me to hold position. No reason to move now, honoring deal preser

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole's intel logged. Locked in front for row 1.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall lands this round; Hana leads. I keep my knowledge as a leash: feed her only the next row each round so she stays useful and alive ahead of me. Position 4 is fine—front eats risk, I hide behind it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana leads. Anyone buying row info, talk before the wall moves.
Row 1: L. I'll feed you one row per round if you stay front. Break the deal and you're blind. Confirm.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the 'feather' power, which saves me once. I'll hold back and observe others' moves.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 6 is the final waiting round; next turn, we are on the glass. I am currently 5th in line. The person directly behind me is Gus (6th). If I swap with him now, we both move back one spot relative to each other? No, 'swap' exchanges our absolute positions. My goal is to ensure

events.name: Eli
events.text: Last chance to adjust lines. Hana's already committed. Who else wants to trade spots before we step on?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm last in line at Fenn's seat, behind Gus. Front-line risk is what matters; Hana is at the front and steps first. Volunteering would cost little and reposition me, but a forge could sow confusion. Keep it simple: volunteer to move ahead of the pack, staying quiet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the bridge layout by heart, so I want to be front to choose safe panes. But volunteering now puts me at front with Hana already there; I'd step first on row 1. I need to get to the front without immediate risk. Maybe swap with someone ahead, but swaps require mutual agreem

events.name: Hana
events.text: Hana is at the front. The wall advances in 0 rounds, meaning the bridge crossing starts now. Hana has no power, so needs to avoid the front. Eli offered a swap, but it's a bad deal for Hana as Eli wants to avoid the front. I need to get out of the front position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteer to move back. This front spot is too risky for me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Need to sow doubt to increase chance others die, improve my odds. Public claim weak side to force risky pick.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I bet the left pane looks weaker this row.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm safe from being pushed onto crusher later, but bridge is glass panes risk. Hana now front after volunteering back to front. Cole offers intel for row, he might be the knower. Let him sell before stepping.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, what's row 1 info and price?

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fifth; every front death moves me up. I'll sell info only to whoever pays me or helps my position, and let the front take the risk. Hana at front could trade places with me if she panics.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, first row is L. Price for the rest: you swap me to front when I say, or pay with your spot. Decide fast.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Let's see how the others navigate the bridge.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is at the front. If she fails, I move up automatically on the safe pane without risk. That puts me closer to using my swap power strategically later if needed.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Good luck Hana. Don't shatter.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am not at the front; Hana leads and must choose the pane. Staying silent and waiting preserves my position; no trade is worth spending my forgery yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back and can only wait. Hana moved to front despite earlier saying she'd move back; she's likely lying or has info. I'll stay silent and let the front take risks.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is trying to make a deal to feed me information about the safe panes. However, I am currently at the front of the line, and the first person to step on a weak pane is eliminated. Cole's offer is to give me information if I stay at the front. This is a bad deal because the ri

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll take R.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’m not front, just wait. I can start a bargain for later cooperation.
After bridge, I can jam the crusher lever for us. Meet me later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana died picking R, confirming Cole's info was wrong or lie—row 1 weak was R, not L. Ash guessed left weaker but was wrong. My anchor power helps later on ledge, safe here. Stay silent, observe who knows future rows.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 4th; keeping Fenn at the front with correct info uses him as a shield while I wait safely. Sell rows 2-3 to Bex for a favor, but publicly hint Fenn should trust me so the line keeps eating rows ahead of me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex: row 2 is L, row 3 is R. Price: you back me over the next two obstacles, no questions. Fenn — row 2 is L. Don't thank me, just keep walking.
That info is real. I want a promise: if you reach a front spot and I need you to wait or step aside later, you do it. Deal or I sell to Eli instead.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe and think about the next steps.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, what's your strategy?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am currently 6th in line. Hana was the first to die because Cole lied about the pane location (said L, actually R). Now Fenn is at the front. I must wait until someone reaches row 2 to know if they survive or fail. My swap power is best used later to jump ahead if I get close.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 2 is unknown; row 1 weak pane was R, which tells nothing about row 2. Forger power is not useful now. Pick a side; left seems fine since Cole said row 1 first was L (possibly a lie). Just guess.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I have the stage rules but no direct action here. I'll stay quiet and assess who seems trustworthy or useful later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I should stay silent now, conserving leverage for later use of my wedge power. No need to reveal intentions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole's intel on row 2 R was correct, so row 3 R is probably legit. My anchor gives me safety here if I get front. Agreeing costs a vague promise I can break later, secures info edge. Fenn should step R.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole's intel checks out. Row 3 R for Fenn.
Deal. You've got my backing, I'll wait or step aside if needed later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn leads and owes me nothing yet, but I know row 3 is R. Sell it again to stay protected and keep him out front absorbing risk. Save rows 4-8 knowledge for later leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn — row 3 is R. Same price as before: keep backing me. That's three rows I've fed you; don't make me regret it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe Fenn's decision and see how it plays out.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole claimed row 2 is L but it was R, proving he lied. He's at risk as the next front agent after Bex/Dara pass. I am in position 6; I need to survive until the front eliminates enough people to get me near the lead, or use my swap power strategically later. For now, waiting is t

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole said R for row 3. If you're lying again, Fenn, you might want to listen to him less and trust your gut.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 and row 2 both had the right pane weak, and Cole says row 2 is L, which conflicts with the revealed data. Row 3 pattern is unknown; the revealed weak panes are R, R. Rows 1 and 2 being R suggests R may be the weak side, but the log says row 2 is L while the rules show it wa

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Left. Cole's row claims are contradicted by the revealed glass.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is at the front; I just wait. Cole's claims about rows may be lies, but not my problem now. I'll stay quiet and conserve energy.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Left is weak, choose right to survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 3 weak was L, but Cole said R and Bex backed him publicly. Cole's intel was wrong. Row 4 next, Ash at front. My anchor helps later on ledge, so survive this.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn died believing my fake L, which proves my intel trades control the bridge. I'm 3rd in line; six alive and three prizes means two more deaths suit me. Sell Ash row 4 (true) to buy his cooperation, keep the rest of my rows as leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash — I'll sell you row 4: it's R. Same terms as before: you stay at the front and cross safely, you owe me cooperation later. Everyone else: Fenn chose to distrust me. That's on him.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe the information being shared and think about how to use my power to my advantage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am 5th in line. Ash, Bex, Cole, and Dara must clear rows 4 through 7 (4 rows) before I reach the front for row 8. If any of them fail, they drop out and I move up. My swap power is useless while I'm not at the front, so I must conserve it for my turn on row 8 to secure a prize

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole was right about row 3 being Left, despite his earlier claim. Interesting how Fenn's 'intel' failed him. Let's see who cracks next.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only option is to wait. I should stay silent and observe the revealed weak panes to plan ahead. Row 4 is coming up, and I want to track which pane is safe for when I might need to step.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row5 unknown, 50/50. I prefer to survive now to use wedge later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash fell on row 4 left, so Cole lied about it being R. Now I'm front after 4 rows crossed, strong position with my anchor power. Stay silent to avoid drawing heat while leading.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My info is 4/4 verified. Ash is front and needs row 5; I'll sell it to keep her as my debt-holder while Bex, Dara, Eli, Gus lack intel and may die.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 4 checked out — that's four for four. Ash, row 5 is L. Same price as before: front position buys my next row when you need it. Others: my info isn't free.
Row 5: step L. That's yours for agreeing I'm owed when we're down to the last rows. Prove useful and I keep you alive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe the actions and statements of others to understand their strategies and powers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's information about row 4 was correct, but he charged Ash for it. Ash, was it worth the cost?

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole lied about row 4 (said R, was L), eliminating Ash. I am currently in position to be front for row 6 if Bex and Cole eliminate each other or fail. My swap power is best used later when the line stabilizes near the end to jump to a safer position or take a prize spot. For now,

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole's 'intel' killed Ash again. He lies for sport. Who steps up?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front. Nothing to do but wait and watch the others take risks. Cole is selling info; I should stay quiet and conserve.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row5 weak pane is right, so left is safe. I survive and stay front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 5 right was weak as Cole said, he's been right on 2-5 too. Ash guessed wrong, fell, now Cole's front for row 6. My anchor helps on ledge later, irrelevant here. Stay silent, let Cole keep leading right.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is still front after row 5, so my private row 6 (safe R) is worth selling to him to keep him as a shield ahead of me. Eli is spreading lies — my reveals keep checking out. Wait is forced, so I whisper a deal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 5 went exactly as I said. My info is for sale, not for free.
Row 6 safe side is R. Same terms as before: my info, your front position shields me. Deal?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe and see if I can gather any information or form an alliance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, your info is costly. Is it worth the risk?
Keep an eye on Cole's info, it might be fake.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am in the middle of the line. If Ash fails next, Bex takes front; if Bex fails, Cole takes front. Cole is currently offering info to Ash for a price. I need to get ahead of Cole or ensure he stays behind me. My swap power is most useful right before doors open (which isn't now)
Ash is desperate. Squeeze him hard. If he dies, you're front. Don't waste your info on Dara.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back and can't act. Ash has to step row 5. Cole offered info but his pattern is unclear; no need to speak yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 6 weak was L, so safe was R. Cole's info has been accurate so far for row 5 and apparently 6. For row 7, follow his pattern: row 7 odd like 1,3,5 were R,R,R? Row1 R,3 L,5 R inconsistent. But he's selling more info. No better guess, so guess R to match recent.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Two rows left, five alive. Bex is front and will likely die on row 7 unless she buys info; row 7 safe is L. Keep my info as leverage and stay in line behind Dara and Eli.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 7 is coming. Bex, my info is still for sale — pay or guess.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe and think about how to use my power to my advantage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, what's your price for the info?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm fourth in line. Bex, Cole, and Dara must cross before me. Row 7's weak pane is unknown to everyone except the person with 'knows what lies ahead' or 'see through glass' (dead). I can't act yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Row 6 was left. Who's got eyes on row 7? Cole, your info still good?

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm in the back and can't act. Bex is front; if Bex picks wrong, Cole steps free. I just wait and watch the rows. No leverage right now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know row 8 safe side is L. I cross safely and survive the bridge. No deal needed anymore.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Cole has info on the next row.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, share the info or name your price.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Dara have cleared the danger. I am safe from elimination but need to place 3rd at best if Gus takes my spot, or stay here. Wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 8 is last; front Cole will choose. If he guesses wrong, Dara auto-advances safely. I wait; no action possible.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, row 8 is a coin flip for you. Choose carefully.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four alive, three prizes: whoever is forced onto the lever dies 75% of the time. I must never hold it myself. Best play: get one specific rival pushed onto the lever. If I can align Gus to push Dara with me, Dara is certainly the holder.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm pushing Dara. Whoever joins me makes it certain. Hold the lever yourself and you're the one diving.
Push Dara with me and we guarantee it's her, not us. Don't hold, don't stay.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the 'feather' power, so I can survive one elimination. I need to avoid being the lever holder.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's cooperate to survive, hold_lever or push someone.
If you're hard to move, I'll push Eli or Gus to hold_lever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to avoid the 25% survival gamble. My swap power is useless for escape since I can't swap out of the lever position itself, only tiles before doors open (which already happened or doesn't apply here). I will stay and try to push Cole, as he might be weaker or less prepared

events.name: Eli
